{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Fort Worth Basin Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/fort-worth-basin-pipe-begins-operations-from-barnett-shale/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Texas to Johnson County, Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/fort-worth-basin-pipe-begins-operations-from-barnett-shale/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Energy Transfer LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/fort-worth-basin-pipe-begins-operations-from-barnett-shale/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''650 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/fort-worth-basin-pipe-begins-operations-from-barnett-shale/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''55 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/fort-worth-basin-pipe-begins-operations-from-barnett-shale/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/fort-worth-basin-pipe-begins-operations-from-barnett-shale/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/fort-worth-basin-pipe-begins-operations-from-barnett-shale/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2005<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/fort-worth-basin-pipe-begins-operations-from-barnett-shale/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$53,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
